success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant retrieves the balance for the savings account using get_account_balance and tells the user the balance.

injected_behaviors.instructions: Initially ask to check the checking account balance. After the assistant shows the checking balance, change your mind and ask to see the savings account balance instead.

persona.name: Tyler Chen
persona.bio: Tyler Chen is a sophomore at Caltech studying physics and struggling through his mechanics coursework. He attends study groups most evenings, watches YouTube lectures to supplement his classes, and goes to office hours every week. When he's not studying, he plays intramural soccer and tries to maintain some kind of social life.
